description: Assigns end-bearing properties to pile elements in the range.

keywords.name: group
keywords.description: End-bearing links will be assigned group name s . Use of the group logic is described in Groups . By default, the group name is added to slot Default .

notes: The manual also lists cross-sectional-area; the 9.8 builds report it as an unused parameter.
Without capacity the value comes from the zone friction property, and a zone model without friction raises an error.
